raw_graphql_pull_request.body: ## Summary DSpark computes a Markov correction across the draft vocabulary at each proposal step. This PR adds an opt-in candidate union: base-logit Top-K plus the previous token's static Markov Top-K. It evaluates the correction only for that union, then passes the same FP32 masked logits through the existing `MarkovSampleStep`, proposal storage, and rejection verification. - Use one option, `--speculative-dspark-markov-topk`, for both sets. The default `0`, or K covering the full draft vocabulary, uses the dense path. Candidate pruning currently supports an ordinary VanillaMarkov head on NVIDIA CUDA with TP=1; other configurations retain the dense path. - Precompute only candidate IDs in bounded chunks. Compute their bias values online; preserve overlapping candidates as one outcome, draft-to-target vocabulary mapping, and negative/zero logit scale. - Reuse the existing per-step loop, Philox sampling and dense proposal probabilities. There is no separate candidate sampler, fused walk kernel, sparse proposal cache, or verifier-normalization change. - Retain the Qwen3 Speculators checkpoint adapter, checkpoint-owned embedding/head and hidden-size projection needed by the tested checkpoint path. Preserve bucketed and direct weight updates, refreshing candidate IDs in place. The simplification follows the request to isolate the candidate-set change in [the related review](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/56694#issuecomment-6269712362). Unrelated PP-stage test coverage is restored. The previous standalone benchmark targeted the removed fused implementation and has been removed. ## Validation Current implementation: [`a720a45705`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40513/commits/a720a45705c3018901666ca058904a647c3d9108). - Python AST, Ruff checks and formatting, whitespace checks, and registered-test lint checks pass locally. - Three focused CPU regressions in the existing `test_dspark_draft_block.py` pass when executing the actual production classes/methods through an AST harness: candidate union/mapping/scale, disabled/full-vocabulary fallback, and bucket/direct weight updates with stable ID-table storage. The weight-update regressions also fail against the old implementations. - Additional CPU checks of the actual block loop and `MarkovSampleStep.torch` cover FP16/BF16/FP32, positive/negative/zero scale, padded anchors, mixed temperatures, stored proposal logits and RNG-offset advancement. - Full pytest collection is blocked in the local environment by missing `triton.backends`. GPU correctness, CUDA graph capture/replay, and throughput have **not** been rerun for this simplified implementation. ## Current GPU validation recipe Use the same checkpoint and workload on the same commit, comparing `--speculative-dspark-markov-topk 0` with `--speculative-dspark-markov-topk 32`. There is no longer a `--speculative-dspark-markov-bias-topk` option or checkpoint-derived candidate budget. ```bash python -m sglang.launch_server \ --model-path /personal/model/Qwen3-4B \ --speculative-algorithm DSPARK \ --speculative-draft-model-path /personal/model/dspark_qwen3_4b_block7 \ --speculative-dspark-block-size 8 \ --speculative-dspark-markov-topk 32 \ --disable-radix-cache \ --port 30012 ``` For the 4B model, start with one GPU and concurrency 1/8/64. Report output tokens/s, TPOT, accepted length, task accuracy, initialization time and memory, at temperatures 0 and 1; include a high-entropy workload. Record the exact commit, checkpoint, GPU/runtime versions and raw results. Multi-GPU/DP measurements can then be reported separately. ## Historical GPU results (before simplification) The commands and images below are retained as evidence for the **previous K32/M0 implementation**. The current single-K design uses K32/M32, changes the proposal set and initialization work, and needs fresh GPU validation. The historical launch includes the now-removed bias-topk option and is not a launch command for the current head. ### Historical launch (previous implementation only) ```bash python -m sglang.launch_server \ --model-path /personal/model/Qwen3-4B \ --speculative-algorithm DSPARK \ --speculative-draft-model-path /personal/model/dspark_qwen3_4b_block7 \ --speculative-dspark-block-size 8 \ --speculative-dspark-markov-topk 32 \ --speculative-dspark-markov-bias-topk 0 \ --dp-size 8 \ --disable-radix-cache \ --host 0.0.0.0 \ --port 30012 ``` ```bash python -m sglang.bench_serving \ --backend sglang-oai-chat \ --base-url http://0.0.0.0:30012 \ --dataset-name openai \ --dataset-path /personal/data/gsm8k/gsm8k.openai.jsonl \ --num-prompts 1000 \ --max-concurrency 32 \ --sharegpt-output-le 3072 \ --output-file /tmp/bench_result.json ``` ### Historical measurements The author measured over 5% output-throughput improvement on different datasets with the previous K32/M0 implementation. These are historical results, not measurements of the simplified implementation. ## Checklist - [x] Follow the repository formatting and code-style checks. - [x] Add focused regressions in the existing unit-test file. - [x] Document the current option and validation limits. - [ ] Run full accelerator tests and refresh accuracy/performance results for the simplified head. - [ ] Obtain required CODEOWNER approval and enabled GPU CI. --- ### CI States Latest PR Test (Base): :x: [Run #39289554567](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39289554567) Latest PR Test (Extra): :x: [Run #39289557733](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39289557733) Latest PR Test (AMD ROCm 10): :x: [Run #39289554407](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39289554407)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# Speculators field semantics follow vLLM's transformers_utils/configs/speculators
+# (Copyright contributors to the vLLM project); no vLLM runtime dependency.
+"""Normalize the data-only Speculators DSpark schema before HF architecture lookup."""
+
+from numbers import Integral
+from typing import Any
+
+
+def normalize_speculators_dspark_config(config: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Return a native DSpark config; applying this twice is a no-op.
+
+    Speculators counts query rows in block_size. SGLang stores the number of
+    proposed tokens there, and its target layer IDs refer to decoder outputs
+    (HF auxiliary hidden states include the embedding at index zero).
+    """
+    if config.get("speculators_model_type") != "dspark":
+        return config
+    if config.get("_sglang_speculators_dspark_normalized", False):
+        return config
+    layers = config.get("transformer_layer_config")
+    if not isinstance(layers, dict):
+        raise ValueError("Speculators DSpark requires transformer_layer_config object.")
+    if layers.get("model_type") not in (None, "qwen3") or "Qwen3OmniDSparkModel" in (
+        config.get("architectures") or []
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "SGLang Speculators DSpark currently supports the Qwen3 dense backbone only."
+        )
+    use_aux = config.get(
+        "use_aux_hidden_state", layers.get("use_aux_hidden_state", True)
+    )
+    if use_aux is False:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "SGLang Speculators DSpark requires use_aux_hidden_state=True; "
+            "the current context-KV path requires trained fc projection weights."
+        )
+    normalized = dict(layers)
+    normalized["model_type"] = "qwen3"
+    normalized["architectures"] = ["Qwen3DSparkModel"]
+    aux = config.get("aux_hidden_state_layer_ids")
+    if (
+        not isinstance(aux, (list, tuple))
+        or not aux
+        or any(isinstance(i, bool) or not isinstance(i, Integral) or i < 1 for i in aux)
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Speculators DSpark requires non-empty positive aux_hidden_state_layer_ids."
+        )
+    normalized["eagle_aux_hidden_state_layer_ids"] = list(aux)
+    normalized["target_layer_ids"] = [int(i) - 1 for i in aux]
+    sample_from_anchor = config.get("sample_from_anchor", False)
+    if not isinstance(sample_from_anchor, bool):
+        raise ValueError("Speculators DSpark sample_from_anchor must be a boolean.")
+    normalized["sample_from_anchor"] = sample_from_anchor
+    block_size = config.get("block_size")
+    if isinstance(block_size, bool) or not isinstance(block_size, Integral):
+        raise ValueError("Speculators DSpark block_size must be an integer.")
+    gamma = int(block_size) - int(not sample_from_anchor)
+    if gamma < 1:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Speculators DSpark block_size must provide at least one draft token."
+        )
+    normalized["block_size"] = gamma
+    # Speculators' confidence defaults differ from legacy SGLang DSpark.
+    normalized.setdefault("enable_confidence_head", False)
+    normalized.setdefault("confidence_head_with_markov", False)
+    for name in (
+        "draft_vocab_size",
+        "target_vocab_size",
+        "target_hidden_size",
+        "mask_token_id",
+        "markov_rank",
+        "markov_head_type",
+        "logit_scale",
+        "enable_confidence_head",
+        "confidence_head_with_markov",
+        "use_aux_hidden_state",
+    ):
+        if config.get(name) is not None:
+            normalized[name] = config[name]
+    normalized["speculators_model_type"] = "dspark"
+    normalized["_sglang_speculators_dspark_normalized"] = True
+    return normalized

 class VanillaMarkov(BaseDSparkMarkovHead):
-    def __init__(self, *, vocab_size: int, markov_rank: int) -> None:
+    def __init__(
+        self,

+        vocab_size: int,
+        markov_rank: int,
+        draft_vocab_size: Optional[int] = None,
+        logit_scale: float = 1.0,

         super().__init__()

+        self.draft_vocab_size = int(
+            vocab_size if draft_vocab_size is None else draft_vocab_size
+        )
+        if self.vocab_size <= 0 or self.draft_vocab_size <= 0:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "DSpark input and draft vocabulary sizes must be positive."
+            )
+        self.target_vocab_size = self.draft_vocab_size
+        self.logit_scale = float(logit_scale)
+        self.register_buffer("draft_id_to_target_id", None, persistent=False)
+        self.register_buffer("_target_token_ids", None, persistent=False)
+        self.register_buffer("candidate_ids", None, persistent=False)
+        self.candidate_topk = 0
         self.markov_rank = int(markov_rank)
         if self.markov_rank <= 0:
             raise ValueError(
                 f"VanillaMarkov requires markov_rank > 0, got {self.markov_rank}."
             )
         self.markov_w1 = nn.Embedding(self.vocab_size, self.markov_rank)
-        self.markov_w2 = nn.Linear(self.markov_rank, self.vocab_size, bias=False)
+        self.markov_w2 = nn.Linear(self.markov_rank, self.draft_vocab_size, bias=False)
+
+    def configure_target_vocab(self, target_vocab_size: int, offsets) -> None:
+        self.target_vocab_size = int(target_vocab_size)
+        self.draft_id_to_target_id = offsets
+        self._target_token_ids = (
+            None
+            if offsets is None
+            else torch.arange(offsets.numel(), device=offsets.device) + offsets
+        )
+
+    def to_target_logits(self, logits: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Dense fallback samples in target space, including reduced-vocab drafts."""
+        if self._target_token_ids is None:
+            return logits
+        out = logits.new_full((*logits.shape[:-1], self.target_vocab_size), -torch.inf)
+        return out.index_copy_(-1, self._target_token_ids, logits)
+
+    @torch.no_grad()
+    def configure_candidates(self, topk: int) -> None:
+        """Use one K for the base-logit and Markov-bias candidate sets."""
+        if topk < 0:
+            raise ValueError("DSpark candidate topk must be nonnegative.")
+        self.candidate_topk = topk if 0 < topk < self.draft_vocab_size else 0
+        if not self.candidate_topk:
+            self.candidate_ids = None
+            return
+        self.candidate_ids = torch.empty(
+            (self.markov_w1.num_embeddings, topk),
+            dtype=torch.int64,
+            device=self.markov_w1.weight.device,
+        )
+        self.refresh_candidates()
+
+    @torch.no_grad()
+    def refresh_candidates(self) -> None:
+        """Rebuild IDs in place so captured graphs retain the same table."""
+        if getattr(self, "candidate_ids", None) is None:
+            return
+        if self.logit_scale == 0:
+            self.candidate_ids.copy_(
+                torch.arange(self.candidate_topk, device=self.candidate_ids.device)
+            )
+            return
+        w2 = self.markov_w2.weight.float().T
+        # Bound the projection workspace; never materialize [Vprev, Vdraft].
+        chunk = max(1, min(128, (64 << 20) // (self.draft_vocab_size * 4)))
+        for start in range(0, self.markov_w1.num_embeddings, chunk):
+            stop = start + chunk
+            bias = self.markov_w1.weight[start:stop].float() @ w2
+            ids = bias.topk(
+                self.candidate_topk, dim=-1, largest=self.logit_scale > 0
+            ).indices
+            self.candidate_ids[start:stop].copy_(ids)
+
+    def candidate_logits(
+        self, prev_tokens: torch.Tensor, base_logits: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> Optional[torch.Tensor]:
+        """Return the candidate proposal in target vocabulary, before temperature."""
+        if getattr(self, "candidate_ids", None) is None:
+            return None
+        base_ids = base_logits.topk(self.candidate_topk, dim=-1, sorted=False).indices
+        static_ids = self.candidate_ids[prev_tokens]
+        ids = torch.cat((base_ids, static_ids), dim=-1)
+        scores = base_logits.gather(-1, ids).float()
+        if self.logit_scale != 0:
+            prev = self.get_prev_embeddings(prev_tokens).float()
+            weights = self.markov_w2.weight[ids].float()
+            bias = (weights * prev[:, None, :]).sum(dim=-1)
+            scores = scores + self.logit_scale * bias
+        target_ids = ids
+        if self.draft_id_to_target_id is not None:
+            target_ids = ids + self.draft_id_to_target_id[ids]
+        finite = torch.isfinite(scores).any(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
+        scores = torch.where(finite, scores, -torch.inf)
+        logits = torch.full(
+            (base_logits.shape[0], self.target_vocab_size),
+            -torch.inf,
+            dtype=torch.float32,
+            device=base_logits.device,
+        )
+        # Each set has unique IDs. Separate writes give their overlap one score,
+        # instead of treating a duplicated candidate as extra probability mass.
+        k = self.candidate_topk
+        logits.scatter_(-1, target_ids[:, :k], scores[:, :k])
+        logits.scatter_(-1, target_ids[:, k:], scores[:, k:])
+        # A row without finite candidates is a point mass at its lowest target ID.
+        fallback = target_ids.amin(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
+        logits.scatter_(
+            -1, fallback, torch.where(finite, logits.gather(-1, fallback), 0.0)
+        )
+        return logits
 
     def get_prev_embeddings(self, token_ids: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
         return self.markov_w1(token_ids.long())

         return self.markov_w2.weight if self._bias_is_w2_gemv() else None

+        self.draft_vocab_size = self.vocab_size

+class TestMarkovCandidates(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_union_preserves_scores_and_target_ids(self):
+        """Overlapping sets must not double bias or double the proposal mass."""
+        head = VanillaMarkov(vocab_size=8, draft_vocab_size=4, markov_rank=1).to(
+            torch.bfloat16
+        )
+        with torch.no_grad():
+            head.markov_w1.weight.fill_(1)
+            head.markov_w2.weight.copy_(torch.tensor([[1], [4], [3], [-2]]))
+        target_ids = torch.tensor([3, 6, 1, 7])
+        head.configure_target_vocab(8, target_ids - torch.arange(4))
+        prev = torch.tensor([2])
+        base = torch.tensor([[6, 5, 0, 1]], dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        for scale, scores in (
+            (1.0, [7, 9, 3, -torch.inf]),
+            (-1.0, [5, 1, -torch.inf, 3]),
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(scale=scale):
+                head.logit_scale = scale
+                head.configure_candidates(2)
+                logits = head.candidate_logits(prev, base)
+                expected = torch.full((1, 8), -torch.inf)
+                expected[0, target_ids] = torch.tensor(scores)
+                self.assertEqual(logits.dtype, torch.float32)
+                torch.testing.assert_close(logits, expected)
+
+        head.logit_scale = 0
+        head.refresh_candidates()
+        logits = head.candidate_logits(prev, base)
+        finite = torch.isfinite(logits)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            logits[finite], head.to_target_logits(base)[finite].float()
+        )
+        torch.testing.assert_close(logits[0, target_ids[:2]], base[0, :2].float())
+
+        head.logit_scale = 1
+        head.refresh_candidates()
+        logits = head.candidate_logits(prev, torch.full_like(base, -torch.inf))
+        expected = torch.full((1, 8), -torch.inf)
+        expected[0, 1] = 0  # Lowest target ID in the union, not target token zero.
+        torch.testing.assert_close(logits, expected)
